up: Return the list of molecules (compounds) reported in the document with ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL5727500. Include the molecule's preferred name and ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727500'
